(1) A REGRESSION the changed area introduced: the rebuilt strategy guide drops its measured anchor when it is hidden, so the collapsed "G GUIDE" chip is drawn over the FFX-2 boss nameplate, HP bar and SCAN label at 1600x900 and 2000x1012 (PR-0050, traced to strategy-guide.css:373 and StrategyGuide.ts:337, both rewritten in this candidate). (4) The PR-0009 repair rebuilt the guide column without raising its type, so the surface the changed area rewrote still renders at 11.5-13.25 effective px at 1600x900 and 2.8 px at 390x844 (PR-0001).
